newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: C&C to set up Australian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: C&C to set up Australian joint venture.

text.p: Motor distributor Cycle & Carriage Ltd (C&C) said on Thursday it had agreed with Astre Investment Pte Ltd and St George Bank Ltd to set up a motor finance company in Australia.
Astre, in which C&C has a 49 percent, has the rights to distribute several brands of cars in Australia. Its turnover was A$1.0 billion in 1996.
The joint venture finance company is expected to have an initial share capital of A$6 million and will be owned 20 percent by C&C, 35 percent by Astre and 45 percent by St George.
The venture is not expected to have a material impact on C&C's earnings for the current financial year, said a company statement.
